coach.tooShortBody: One or two words gives a reader nothing to reply to. A specific example says far more.
coach.addSpecific: Say it in your own words
coach.addSpecificBody: The answers people respond to name something concrete — a place, a habit, a reason.
coach.goodBody: Specific and in your own voice. That is exactly what gives someone a reason to write back.

outlook.intro: No right answers — just which one is more you. Takes about five minutes, and you can change any of it later.
